howToUse:
1. Enter your raw project idea or concept.
2. Select the Project Type (e.g., Marketing, Logo/Branding).
3. Choose the Brand Vibe and Target Audience.
4. Pick your desired output format.
5. Click 'Generate Brief'.
features:
• Structured Briefs
